rows: Includes Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Filipino, Vietnamese, Asian Indian

Each surgical episode was anchored to one eligible noncardiac index surgery and comprised a 7-day preoperative and up-to-30-day postoperative event stream, regardless of coded PO-AKI status.

tables.title: Table 2. Surgery-index and postoperative dynamic predictive performance
rows: Values are mean (minimum, maximum) across five fold-specific models evaluated on the same held-out temporal test set.

tables.title: Table 3. Ablation analysis of STREAM
rows: † The no-baseline-loss model did not train the surgery-index prediction head; its surgery-index AUPRC  is therefore shown only to demonstrate dependence of the baseline head on explicit supervision. * Lower than the full model in all five folds. Values are five-fold means (%); values in parentheses are the mean paired within-fold change from the full model in percentage points, computed before rounding. Dynamic macro-AUPRC was calculated separately within each valid 6-hour postoperative interval and summarized as the unweighted mean across intervals.

tables.title: Supplementary Table S2. STREAM architecture and training configuration.
Algorithm 1  Unified training and evaluation of fixed-window time-series baselines
rows: Split Ddev by patient; fit normalization and μ on training only.
Build X ∈ ℝ^(149×548): 28 pre, 1 index, 120 post; retain M, Δ, V.
X̃ ← LOCF(X); impute missing numerical values by causal LOCF, then μ.
A ← block mask: pre ↔ pre; index ← pre + index; post ← index + current/prior post.
Train across epochs using surgery-index BCE and V-masked postoperative BCE.
Evaluate selected checkpoint on the same Dtest.
return mean (minimum, maximum) test metrics across five folds.

tables.title: Supplementary Table S7. Complete surgery-index performance of STREAM ablation variants.
rows: Values are mean ± SD across five fold-specific models (%). Each episode contributes one surgery-index prediction (n = 23,538; coded PO-AKI prevalence, 10.1%). Threshold-dependent metrics use a probability threshold of 0.50.  †The no-baseline-loss variant did not train the surgery-index prediction head; these metrics are shown only to demonstrate its dependence on explicit supervision. ‡In one fold, the surgery-index head predicted no positive cases; precision and F1 were therefore set to 0 for that fold.

tables.title: Supplementary Table S8. Complete postoperative dynamic performance of STREAM ablation variants
rows: Values are mean ± SD across five fold-specific models (%). Postoperative metrics were calculated separately within each valid 6-hour interval and macro-averaged across intervals, as defined in the main Methods. Threshold-dependent metrics use a probability threshold of 0.50.
